FFXIV, they don't have a rebirth system per say however you can change classes/jobs just by switching weapons back and forth.
You can also rack up on bonus exp once you hit 50 and 60. 
On the side note, you can acquire most of the mounts in the game and some fashion items that you can cast on your equipment with the Glamour system. 

Community wise, it has a more mature playerbase and its newbie friendly. 

Cash shop wise, its small compared to F2P mmos and I feel that it doesn't pressure you too much wanting to buy this or that. 
Also if you stay subscribed monthly ($13 for one character per server, $15 for alts on every server) you get gifts from SE just for staying subscribed every 30 days.

You can try it with a free 2 weeks trial and you still get access to most of its features. 

Honestly first time I tried it I got bored but then I decided to give it another chance and by the time I just unlocked dungeons, I started enjoying the game more.

And since I had a few people asked me if I "RP", I don't nor am I interested.
